title: Emit fully qualified image locations in the public sitemap

verify.note: Executes actual sitemap URL projection with installed Next XML serializer and parses the emitted XML. Root/path/protocol-relative images resolve to configured public origin or external CDN, HTTP(S) CDNs survive, invalid schemes/credentials are omitted. Same acceptance rejects former relative projection. Offline/local proof; not deployed.

detail: Read-only production sitemap observation found six relative image:loc values under The Group Space profiles. Google sitemap guidance requires complete absolute URLs; image extensions inherit generic sitemap rules. The final shared sitemap projection now resolves image paths against configured SITE_URL, never request Host, preserves legitimate external HTTP(S) CDNs, removes fragments and omits malformed/unsupported/credential-bearing image URLs. Existing XML escaping and page/entity URL/canonical/visibility gates remain. Actual route tests parse Next output and reject the former behavior. No provider/DB/content mutations; no migration; full audit remains open. Reference: https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/sitemaps/build-sitemap and https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/sitemaps/image-sitemaps.
